column3: “Hearts” is plural where Egypt has one collective heart.
“Masters” is plural where the master is qualified in the singular.
“Nile” identifies the sea’s waters, and “riverbed” specifies the river.
The combing of the flax is not explicit; “turn pale” supplies a second predicate.
“Workers in cloth” replaces the image of foundations.
“One of the wise” replaces a son of the wise; “eastern” stands for ancient.
The misleading by unnamed agents is rendered passively.
“City of the Sun” stands for the supplied Hebrew wording “City of Destruction.”
“Three-party alliance” supplies an alliance to Israel being a third.
